answer_1.quote: Structured data-to-text generation is the task of generating natural language sentences from the data in a structured format, such as tables, knowledge graphs, or databases.

answer_2.quote: We employ standard metrics BLEU, ME-TEOR, ROUGE-L and BERTScore to measure saliency of the generated text by comparing it with the pre-processed ground-truth text. To verify the faithfulness of the generated text with respect to the input image(s), we utilize the CLIP score (Hessel et al., 2021), which is widely used to measures text-image alignment.

answer_3.quote: We prompt GPT-4V with input images and the list of extracted features from (1) to verify whether the feature is visible or not visible in the input images.
